# Meetup

> > Meetup is a platform for discovering and joining local groups, events, and activities to connect with like-minded people in your community.

Meetup enables people to find and create community groups around shared interests including young professionals networking, outdoor activities, tech communities, philanthropy, wellness, and niche hobbies. The platform hosts both in-person and virtual events via Zoom, serving diverse communities from San Jose to Santa Fe and beyond.

## Platform Overview

- [Meetup | Find Local Groups, Events, and Activities Near You](https://www.meetup.com): Homepage for finding local groups, events & connecting with like-minded people

## Young Professionals & Social Groups

- [!"20-30s Young Pros FunMeetup&NYMeetup (Over 10,000 of us !)](https://www.meetup.com/20-30s): Large NYC young professionals social group for ages 20-39 across boroughs
- [20's-30's - Indie Music, Brews, Outdoors, and Fun Times](https://www.meetup.com/20s-30s-indie-music-brews-outdoors-and-fun-times): San Diego young professionals group for indie music, comedy & outdoor activities

## Community & Philanthropy Groups

- [100 Women Who Care in Santa Fe](https://www.meetup.com/100-women-who-care-in-santa-fe): Women's philanthropy group focused on charitable giving in Santa Fe area
- [3-2-1 Appleton Kiwanis](https://www.meetup.com/321appleton): Modern Kiwanis service club in Appleton helping children with flexible schedule
- [2022 California Coastal Cleanup Day](https://www.meetup.com/2022-california-coastal-cleanup-day): Coastwalk California beach cleanup event in Sonoma County removing marine debris

## Tech & Professional Development

- [STARTALK "Defining the Consumer Journey Experience to Build Loyalty"](https://www.meetup.com/11486e48-3723-42d1-99d0-f6625d813c5e/events/278590122): Startup event on consumer loyalty with Fendy Chang from Ralali.com via Zoom
- ["You are not an Imposter"- March meet-up](https://www.meetup.com/1e7d6f7d-f26f-489f-bf63-419ac5dd4f0a/events/259650328): Doyenne Coders women in tech meetup addressing imposter syndrome at TUSpark
- [Kick-Off & Kirby 4](https://www.meetup.com/31f3a2bd-8704-4d24-8022-a26173d9d87e/events/297333987): Hamburg Kirby CMS community kick-off event discussing Kirby 4 release
- [Encuentro de Octubre](https://www.meetup.com/36c88511-640e-4685-95f7-300d1cb31d88/events/141163632): Mozilla Community Madrid October meetup featuring FirefoxOS lightning talks

## Wellness & Support Groups

- [The Reiki and "In Light"-enment Energy Healing School](https://www.meetup.com/333wellnes): Orlando energy healing school offering Reiki, meditation & healing modalities
- [Young Adults Aspergers and Autism spectrum meet up!](https://www.meetup.com/20s-and-30s-aspergers-and-autism-spectrum-meet-up): Support group for young adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder in Lawrenceville
- [Ladies Holiday GROOVE Delicious Dance Party mix & mingle](https://www.meetup.com/1ab191ba-c1f9-4485-9408-5a83f15c79a3/events/235676240): Women's dance fitness event using The GROOVE Method by Misty Tripoli

## Specialized Interest Groups

- [1825 Colony Social](https://www.meetup.com/1825colony): Texas heritage group celebrating Native Texan history & culture in Salado
- [Life Science After Work Meetup #1](https://www.meetup.com/1aee7921-ab57-4dc0-9aae-60bd92c4e000/events/301134283): Life science professionals networking event in Kaunas hosted by Nordclinic
- [Optimerad livskvalite hand i hand med maximerad affärsframgång med Håkan Nilsson](https://www.meetup.com/2e7f1dea-345f-4c07-b4d5-ad59b8ec5936/events/291042758): Afterwork on work-life balance & business success with Håkan Nilsson at Sanna
